arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīn
english_text: "Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds" (1:2)!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لَـكَ الْحَمْدُ بَدِيْعَ السَّموَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ،
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu badi' al-samawati wa al-ard
english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise! Originator of the heavens and the earth!

arabic_text: ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
transliteration: dhā al-jalāli wal-ikrām
english_text: Possessor of majesty and munificence!

arabic_text: رَبَّ الاَرْبَابِ وَإلهَ كُلِّ مَألُوه،
transliteration: rabb al-arbāb wa-ilāh kulli maʾaluh
english_text: Lord of lords! Object of worship of every worshiper!

arabic_text: وَخَالِقَ كُلِّ مَخْلُوق،
transliteration: wa khāliqa kulli makhlooq
english_text: Creator of every creature!

arabic_text: وَوَارِثَ كُلِّ شَيْء، لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَـيْءٌ، وَلا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ عِلْمُ شَيْء، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْء مُحِيطٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء رَقِيبٌ،
transliteration: wa waritha kulli shay'in, laysa kamithlihi shay'un wa lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu ʿilmu shayʾ wa huwa bikulli shay'in muheetun wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in raqīb
english_text: Inheritor of all things! "There is nothing like Him" (42:11), knowledge of nothing escapes Him, He "encompasses everything" (41:54), and He is watchful over everything (ref.33:52).

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الله لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الاَحَـدُ الْمُتَوَحِّدُ الْفَرْدُ الْمُتَفَرِّدُ،
transliteration: 'anta allāh lā ilāha illā 'anta al-'aḥadu al-mutawaḥḥidu al-fard al-mutafarridu
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Unique, the Alone, the Single, the Isolated.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الْمُتَكَرِّمُ، الْعَظِيمُ الْمُتَعَظِّمُ، الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ.
transliteration: wa anta allāhu lā ilāha illā anta al-karīmu al-mutakarrimu al-ʿaẓīmu al-mutaʿaẓẓimu, al-kabīru al-mutakabbiru
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Generous, the Generously Bestowing, the All-mighty, the Mightily Exalted, the Magnificent, the Magnificently Magnified.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ العَلِيُّ الْمُتَعَالِ، الْشَدِيْدُ الْمِحَـالِ.
transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-'aliyyu al-muta'aal, al-shadiidu al-mihaal
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-high, the Sublimely High, "the Strong in prowess" (13:13).

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الـرَّحْمنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ.
transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, ar-rahmanu ar-rahim, al-'alimu al-hakim
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate, the All-knowing, the All-wise.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ الْقَدِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ،
transliteration: wa anta allahu la ilaha illa anta, assamīʿu al-baṣīru al-qadīmu al-khabīru
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-hearing, the All-seeing, the Eternal, the All-aware.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الاَكْرَمُ الدَّائِمُ الادْوَمُ،
transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-karim al-akram, al-daim al-adwam
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Generous, the Most Generous, the Everlasting, the Most Everlasting.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الاوَّلُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ أَحَد وَالاخِرُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ عَدَد،
transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-awwal qabla kulli ahadin wa al-ākhiru baʿda kulli ʿadad
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the First before every one, the Last after every number.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الدَّانِي فِي عُلُوِّهِ، وَالْعَالِي فِي دُنُوِّهِ،
transliteration: wa anta allahu la ilaha illa anta addani fi 'uluwwihi wal-ʿālī fī dunyāhi
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Close in His highness, the High in His closeness.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ ذُو الْبَهَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ.
transliteration: wa anta allāh lā ilāha illā anta dhū al-bahā'i wal-majdi wal-kibriyā'i wal-ḥamd
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, Possessor of radiance and glory, magnificence and praise.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأْتَ الاشْيَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سِنْخ، وَصَوَّرْتَ مَا صَوَّرْتَ مِنْ غَيْرِ مِثال، وَابْتَدَعْتَ الْمُبْتَدَعَاتِ بِلاَ احْتِذَآء.
transliteration: wa-anta allāh lā ilāha illā anta al-ladhī anshata al-ashyā'a min ghayr sinakh wa ṣawwartama ṣawwartamin ghayri mithāl wa ibtadat al-mubtadaʿat bi-lā ihtidhāʾ
english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou. Thou hast brought forth the things without root, formed what Thou hast formed without exemplar, and originated the originated things without limitation.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي قَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَقْدِيراً وَيَسَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَيْسِيراً، وَدَبَّرْتَ مَا دُونَكَ تَدْبِيْراً.
transliteration: 'anta alladhi qaddarta kulla shay'in taqdiran wayassart(a) kulla shay'in taysira(n) wadabbar-ta mā doonaka tadbeeran
english_text: It is Thou who hast ordained each thing with an ordination, eased each thing with an easing, and governed everything below Thyself with a governing.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لَمْ يُعِنْكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ شَرِيكٌ وَلَمْ يُؤازِرْكَ فِي أَمْرِكَ وَزِيرٌ،
transliteration: wa anta allathi lam yu`inaka `ala khalqika shariqun walam yuʾāzirka fī amrika wazīrun
english_text: It is Thou whom no associate helps with Thy creation and no vizier aids in Thy command.

arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ مُشَاهِدٌ وَلا نَظِيرٌ.
transliteration: wa lam yakun laka mushahidun wala nathirun
english_text: Thou hast no witness and no equal.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَرَدْتَ فَكَانَ حَتْماً مَا أَرَدْتَ، وَقَضَيْتَ فَكَانَ عَدْلاً مَا قَضَيْتَ، وَحَكَمْتَ فَكَانَ نِصْفاً مَا حَكَمْتَ،
transliteration: 'anta alladhī aradta fakāna ḥatman mā aradta waqaḍayta fakāna ʿadlan mā qaḍayta waḥakamta fakana niṣfan mā ḥakamta
english_text: It is Thou who willed, and what Thou willed was unfailing, who decreed, and what Thou decreed was just, who decided, and what Thou decided was fair.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّـذِي لا يَحْوِيْـكَ مَكَانٌ وَلَمْ يَقُمْ لِسُلْطَانِكَ سُلْطَانٌ، وَلَمْ يُعْيِكَ بُرْهَانٌ وَلا بَيَانٌ.
transliteration: anta alladhi la yahwik maakan walam yaqum lisultanika sultanun walam yuʿyika burhanun wala bayanun
english_text: It is Thou whom place does not contain, before whose authority no authority stands up, and whom no proof or explication can thwart.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَحْصَيْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء عَدَدَاً، وَجَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ شَيْء أَمَداً، وَقَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَقْدِيْراً.
transliteration: 'anta alladhi 'ahsayta kulla shay'in 'adada wa jaʿalta likulli shay'in amadan wa qaddarta kulla shay'in taqdeeran
english_text: It is Thou who hast counted everything in numbers, appointed for everything a term, and ordained everything with an ordination.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي قَصُرَتِ الاوْهَامُ عَنْ ذَاتِيَّتِكَ، وَعَجَزَتِ الافْهَامُ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّتِكَ ، وَلَمْ تُدْرِكِ الابْصَارُ مَوْضِعَ أَيْنِيَّتِكَ.
transliteration: 'anta alladhī qasurat al-awhāmu 'an dhātiyyatika waʿajazati al-afhāmu ʿan kayfiyyatika wa lam tudrikil-absaru mawdi'a 'ayniyyatika
english_text: It is Thou before whose selfness imaginations fall short, before whose howness understandings have no incapacity, and the place of whose whereness eyes perceive not.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي لا تُحَدُّ فَتَكُونَ مَحْدُوداً، وَلَمْ تُمَثَّلْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْجُوداً، وَلَمْ تَلِدْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْلُوداً.
transliteration: 'anta alladhī lā tuḥaddu fatakūna maḥdūdan walum tumaththal fatakoona mawjoodan walum talid fatakoonu mawloodan
english_text: It is Thou who hast no bounds, lest Thou be bounded, who art not exemplified, lest Thou be found, who dost not beget, lest Thou be begotten.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي لا ضِدَّ مَعَكَ فَيُعَانِدَكَ، وَلا عِدْلَ فَيُكَاثِرَكَ، وَلاَ نِدَّ لَكَ فَيُعَارِضَكَ.
transliteration: 'anta alladhī lā ḍidda ma'aka fayuʿānidaka walā ʿidlun fayukāthiraka, walā niddun lak fayuʿāriḍaka
english_text: It is Thou with whom there is no opposite, lest it contend with Thee, who hast no equal, lest it vie with Thee, who hast no rival, lest it resist Thee.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّـذِي ابْتَدَأ وَاخْتَـرَعَ وَاسْتَحْدَثَ وَابْتَـدَعَ وَأَحْسَنَ صُنْعَ مَا صَنَعَ،
transliteration: 'anta alladhi ibtada wa-ikhtara'a wa-istahdatha wa'ibtada'a wa ahsana sunʿa ma sanʿa
english_text: It is Thou who art He who began, devised, brought forth, originated, and made well all that He made.

arabic_text: سُبْحانَكَ! مَا أَجَلَّ شَأنَكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka! mā ʾajalla shaʾnaka
english_text: Glory be to Thee! How majestic is Thy station!

arabic_text: وَأَسْنَى فِي الامَاكِنِ مَكَانَكَ،
transliteration: wa asnaa fil amākin makaanaka
english_text: How high Thy place among the places!

arabic_text: وَأَصْدَعَ بِالْحَقِّ فُرقَانَكَ.
transliteration: wa-asda'a bil-haqqi furqānaka
english_text: How cleanly Thy Separator cleaves with the truth!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ لَطِيفٍ مَا أَلْطَفَكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka min laṭīfin mā alṭafaka
english_text: Glory be to Thee! The Gentle - how gentle Thou art!
